description: This file is a server-side PHP script for the vtiger CRM system, specifically handling the process of saving a bookmarklet, retrieving metadata, managing webservice interactions, and rendering a Smarty template for user interaction.

classes.name: VtigerWebserviceObject
classes.description: A class representing web service objects for interacting with CRM modules.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A class extending Smarty for rendering CRM-specific templates.
